- Confirm whether CP-607691 exists and is Saltmarsh Bakery's commercial property policy with Tamarack General: effective dates, named insured, insured locations (which address the bakery/freezer sits at), limits, deductibles, and whether the policy is in force as of the date of loss.

- If there is a recent endorsement or change affecting this location or the freezer (e.g. new unit, updated equipment schedule, alarm/monitoring), pull that too.

2. OPEN THE CLAIM
- File first notice of loss with Tamarack General for the freezer and stock loss.
- Get back: claim number, adjuster assigned, date of notice, and what the carrier needs next. Capture any deadlines the carrier sets for the notice or documentation.

- Date and time of the compressor failure and date the loss was discovered (these may differ, and both matter).
- Stated cause: mechanical/electrical, age of unit, last service, any prior repair history or warning signs.
- Freezer make, model, serial number, age, and replacement value.
- Stock contents: types and quantities, valuation basis, approximate total value, and whether anything was salvageable or had to be discarded.

- Any business interruption from being unable to operate, and whether that has been reported.

- Include a clear response deadline, the list of acceptable photo formats, and instructions for sending large files if relevant.
- Note in the draft that this is a formal claim documentation request from the adjuster's perspective, and ask Linnea to flag anything she no longer has so we can document it as unavailable rather than leave a gap.

5. WRAP-UP
- Report all of the above in one consolidated update, including anything that did not work, anything the carrier could not confirm, and every open item still owed by Linnea.
